description: Study day, 1 to 14. Day 14 is the final survey, which also held the mind-perception questions
Whether the advice had been given yet. It was shown on day 8, so days 1 to 7 are before and days 8 to 14 are after
Who gave the advice (random assignment). Blank for the 55 people who never got the advice
Hours slept the night before, from the daily survey
Minutes spent on a device in bed the night before, from the daily survey
Weight on advice for sleep: how far the day's sleep moved from the person's days 1 to 7 average toward 8.25 hours, as a share of the distance, capped at -2 and 2
Weight on advice for device time: the same, toward 15 minutes. Blank when the person had no days 1 to 7 average or no value that day
Mean of the seven mind-perception items, from the final survey. Blank for people who did not answer (it is the same on every day for a person)
